title: ss → nwc cross-site feedback message
description: The POST body the Moodle consumer (local/feedback) sends to nwc CrossSiteFeedbackController (POST /api/feedback/log). Consumer-driven surface (Moodle posts). Validated by CrossSiteFeedbackController::validate(). Idempotent on (source, source_ref=ss_feedback:<id>, reason).

ss_feedback_id.description: Moodle-local feedback row id. Part of the idempotency key.

ss_userid.description: Moodle-local user id (NOT the Drupal uid — see oauth_sub for the cross-site key).

oauth_sub.description: == Drupal uid: the UID-lock echoed back. Depends on the oauth_sso surface's `sub` claim (research §1 surface 2).

reviewer_nwc_uid.description: Optional Drupal uid of the reviewer.
